note: Story-relevant item IDs. Echo's item system may add stats; keep IDs.

items.insulin_vial: Theo's insulin. ~30 days each once opened. Checked at Ch3/Ch7/Ch9 checkpoints.
items.gas_can: 5 gal gasoline. Ch1: give to Pruitt or keep (fuel for a small generator/cooler).
items.lineman_tools: Dell's dad's lineman tools. Tradeable to Ray. Without them Ch4 black start is slower.
items.diesel_jug: 5 gal diesel from Ray. Generator fuel (keeps insulin cool in Ch1-3).
items.canned_food: Food. Restores hunger. Also a peace offering (Ch4 Lunds).
items.candles: Light at night; minor warmth indoors.
items.lake_cooler: Crafted. Keeps insulin cool. Sets ch01_cooler_built.
items.pharmacy_bag: Stolen meds. Confiscated at the Ch2 checkpoint unless bribed.
items.ration_card: Authority ration card. Weekly food at the DECC; talk past watch patrols.
items.priority_card: Tier-2 medical priority. Exchange at Lakehead Memorial for 2 insulin_vial.
items.wool_blanket: Warmth. Required to talk down a husk.
items.batteries: Radio/flashlight power. A kindness gift for Lou.
items.relay_kit: Protective relay for Unit 2. From Authority depot or Harbor theft.
items.med_kit: Heals HP. Used to save Cody (Ch5).
items.ironwood_id: Ruiz's ID. One free pass through an Ironwood checkpoint.
items.iodide_tablets: Potassium iodide. Slows RAD gain; needed to talk down a husk.
items.mask_filter: Gas-mask filter. Loads into Dell's utility-crew respirator (has_gas_mask, from Ch8 start). FILTER % on HUD. Theo needs ~2/week in Act III.
